summary_en: ethrex previewed frames-devnet-1, which adds EIP-8250, EIP-8272 and EIP-7906 on top of EIP-8141. Georgios Konstantopoulos said Tempo is not worried about post-quantum safety because configurable accounts can rotate keys in place and disable non-PQ keys. EIP-8288 gained mempool wrappers and proof-carrying inclusion lists. Aztec's Alpha V6 code is ready and enters governance.
